title: Dr. V. Narayanan
documents: Dr. V. Narayanan is the 11th Chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and Secretary of the Department of Space (DOS), assuming office on January 14, 2025.
Prior to his appointment as ISRO Chairman, Dr. V. Narayanan served as the Director of the Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC) in Valiamala, Kerala.
He is a distinguished rocket propulsion scientist specializing in cryogenic engines, liquid propulsion systems, and heavy-lift rocket stage technology for LVM3 and PSLV launchers.

title: SSLV-D3 / EOS-08
documents: SSLV-D3 successfully placed the EOS-08 Earth Observation Satellite and SR-0 DEMOSAT into Low Earth Orbit on August 16, 2024.
This mission marked the successful completion of the Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV) development program, declaring SSLV operational for commercial small satellite launches.
The launch took place from the First Launch Pad at Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC SHAR), Sriharikota.
